About the job

Job Title: Project Director
Location: Europe (Madrid, London, Paris, Hamburg, Düsseldorf, etc.)

Role Summary

The Project Director owns projects end to end, leading execution and delivery for BESS and Wind projects. The role ensures safe and successful delivery and manages key risks, contractual commitments and stakeholder alignment through commissioning, acceptance and close-out.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own delivery governance and HSE, scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk and claims performance.
  • Lead internal engineering, procurement, manufacturing, logistics, construction, commissioning, grid, quality, finance, legal and service stakeholders.
  • Coordinate customers, EPCs, contractors, OEMs, utilities and authorities.
  • Drive project planning, resource allocation, milestones and executive reporting; establish decision and escalation mechanisms.
  • Manage contracts and commercial execution, change orders, payment milestones, claims and disputes.
  • Ensure technical alignment and readiness for BESS and Wind systems, including grid requirements, commissioning plans, guarantees and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage risks and opportunities proactively and spread mitigations and lessons learned across the portfolio.

Qualifications / Experience

  • Significant experience directing large-scale energy-infrastructure projects, ideally utility-scale wind and/or BESS.
  • Strong knowledge of EPC, EPCM and multi-contract delivery models, contract management and project controls.
  • Proven leadership of multi-country or complex-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong communication and executive-level influencing skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Engineering, Project Management or a related field.
